Figure 1: Study design and resource–performance frontier. A lung-focused QC pipeline yields one canonical volume per patient; a leakage-free patient-level split feeds three inputs that differ only in dimensionality (2D, 2.5D, 3D) into matched CNN and ViT backbones, which are evaluated for discrimination, operating behavior, and computational cost. The 2.5D CNN gives the most favorable trade-off.
